Kuldeep Tiwari.
J.(Oral)

1.  The instant petition filed under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C., proffers the hereinafter extracted relief,
as craved by the petitioner, inasmuch as, quashing of the FIR No.0473 dated 08.07.2021, under Sections 406, 418 and 420 of IPC, registered at Police Station Sector-8, Faridabad, Haryana, along with all the consequential proceedings arising therefrom, on the basis of a compromise dated 14.07.2021 (Annexure P-4), as entered into inter se the petitioner and the respondent No.2.
2.

Upon an affirmative response from the learned counsel for the respondent No.2 qua the compromise dated 14.07.2021 (Annexure P-4), a Co- ordinate Bench of this Court through an order drawn on 01.05.2024, upon the instant 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:086920 CRM-M-63064-2023 Dinesh Verma vs State Of Haryana And Anr on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34612961/
1 - 2- petition, directed the parties to appear before the learned trial Court/Illaqa Magistrate concerned, for getting their respective statements recorded qua authenticity of the compromise dated 14.07.2021 (Annexure P-4).

sentences.text: Moreover, the learned trial Court/Illaqa Magistrate concerned was also directed to send a report in the above regard.

3. Consequent to the making of the directions (supra), the parties appeared before the CJ(JD)-cum-JMIC, Faridabad and got their respective statements recorded, thereby authenticating the compromise dated 14.07.2021 (Annexure P-4).

Accordingly, in compliance of the directions (supra) of this Court, a Report bearing No.523 dated 24.05.2024 has been received from the CJ(JD)-cum-JMIC, Faridabad, wherein, a satisfaction has been recorded by the CJ(JD)-cum-JMIC,
Faridabad qua the compromise (supra) being drawn in a genuine and voluntary manner, without any coercion or undue influence.
Moreover, this report also discloses that, in compliance of the order made by this Court on 01.05.2024, the petitioner has placed on file a DD in the sum of Rs.1,50,000/-.
4. This Court has heard counsel for the parties and gone through the case file.

5. A Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, in CRM-M-25669-2020 (O&M), titled "Abhishek Singh &
others V/s State of Punjab & others", Pronounced on:
07.04.2022, while granting a similar relief, as craved in the instant petition, has observed as under:-
"9.

7. Resultantly, FIR No.0473 dated 08.07.2021, under Sections 406, 418 and 420 of IPC, registered at Police Station Sector-8, Faridabad, Haryana, along with all the consequential proceedings arising therefrom, are hereby quashed, on the basis of the compromise dated 14.07.2021 (Annexure P-4),
subject to the payment of costs of Rs.5,000/-, to be forthwith deposited with the District Legal 3 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:086920 CRM-M-63064-2023 - 4- Services Authority concerned.
8.

However, it open for the complainant/respondent No.2 to make an appropriate application before the learned trial Court concerned, for release of the demand draft, which has been, as is evident from the report of the learned Magistrate concerned, deposited before it.
In case, such an application is filed, the learned trial Court concerned shall decide the same in accordance with law.
(KULDEEP TIWARI)
